The gluing along any common development A (S ⊆ A Cauchy, u₁ = u₂ on A) closed in U₁ ∩ U₂ is a Hausdorff, second countable, causal two-piece spacetime étale over M, with S lifted to a Cauchy surface (Causal.EtaleGluing.isEtaleDevelopment, Causal.ers_etale_development). Agreement ⇒ injectivity (reported, not required). Injectivity gives agreement always (eqOn_inter_of_injective_proj). The converse holds in ERS's subluminal setting with S connected and m-acausal: two developments agreeing on U₁ ∩ U₂ have a connected overlap (Causal.ers_isPreconnected_inter_of_eqOn), so π is an open embedding for every open A ⊇ S closed in the overlap (ers_isOpenEmbedding_proj_of_eqOn).
